purpose: Record the research baseline that constrains the AddOne-owned fullscreen Pi UI before implementation proceeds beyond contract and boundary work.

analyzedSurfaces: core/host/pi host bridge and public API providers
ui extension entry and agent-view patching
fragilityFindings: Patched TuiAltScreen, TuiMainScreen, ProcessTerminal, and InteractiveMode behavior
Read private renderer state and prototype method ownership
Hashed published distribution files and pinned exact Pi/TUI package bytes
Required an exact Pi host profile and migration work after Pi upgrades
v2Prototype.reuseDecision: Do not port implementation code. Preserve only the lesson that an owned root is necessary and private Pi coupling is forbidden.

adoptedPatterns: Separate engine events from presentation and interactive orchestration from controllers
Keep controllers separate from renderable components and components separate from terminal emission
Treat native-scrollback transcript output as an append-only commit ledger with explicit live and finalized regions
Use component-owned immutable render results, width-safe sanitization, coalesced rendering, typed input, paste handling, and renderer stress fixtures
Compose status from explicit segments rather than hidden global renderer mutation
Use SDK-backed custom sessions for non-stock UI integration
rejectedScope: Fork-wide engine, provider, tool, and product scope
Deep package exports, oh-my-pi package dependencies, and native N-API UI dependencies
Automatic adoption of upstream UI changes or wholesale directory ports

publicIntegrationSurfaces: typed AgentSession events, snapshots, commands, and services
forbiddenIntegrationSurfaces: prototype patching and private renderer state
deep package imports and distribution-file hash gating
stock extension UI assumptions inside AddOne's owned root

forbidden: private fields or undocumented deep imports
